text: The spontaneous-emission rate A₂₁ scales as ω³, which is one reason lasers are harder to build at visible wavelengths than in the infrared for similar gain cross-sections.
explanation: True: A₂₁ = (ℏω³/π²c³)B₂₁, so spontaneous emission grows rapidly with frequency and competes more strongly with stimulated emission at shorter wavelengths. This ω³ scaling is exactly why short-wavelength lasing is comparatively difficult.
